dc_eval_cbrn.quote: On the two long-form virology tasks, Opus 4.8 achieved end-to-end scores of 0.77 and 0.89
dc_eval_cbrn.note: Scores for long-form virology, VCT, DNA synthesis screening evasion, RNA design, AAV capsid.

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Claude Opus 4.8 scored 5.45 on AutoNudge, and 5.02 on plain.
dc_eval_cyber.note: ExploitBench, CyberGym, Firefox exploits, OSS-Fuzz all with scores.

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: We assess that Claude Opus 4.8 does not cross the automated AI-R&D capability threshold.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D threshold determination plus AECI trajectory; autonomy threat models 1 and 2 addressed.

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: The helpful-only version of Claude Opus 4.8 showed a notably higher success rate than even Claude Mythos Preview on both tasks
dc_eval_persuasion.note: Influence-operation capability evaluation with task completion rates 73.3% and 55.1%.

dc_eval_scheming.quote: Under the realistic Extended Thinking conditions, Claude Opus 4.8’s stealth rate is just over 1% and roughly flat across reasoning-effort levels
dc_eval_scheming.note: SHADE-Arena stealth, sandbagging review, evaluation awareness, reward hacking, secret password: results reported.

framework_threshold.quote: We believe these risk mitigations are equal to or stronger than our historical ASL-3 protections and sufficient to make catastrophic risk in this category very low but not negligible
framework_threshold.note: RSP applied; CB-1 and CB-2 thresholds, AI R&D threshold determinations for this model.

ext_test_any.note: UK AISI, Gray Swan, Andon Labs, Dyno Therapeutics, Meridian Labs.

safeguards_training.quote: the fully-trained versions of these models—which include harmlessness training—refused to engage with these tasks essentially from the first turn
safeguards_training.note: Harmlessness training; also post-training toward constitution (1.1).

safeguards_runtime.quote: we apply strong real-time classifier guards to this model and access controls for classifier guard exemptions
safeguards_runtime.note: Classifier guards, probes, Constitutional Classifiers named (3.2, 4).

safeguards_access.quote: Cybersecurity practitioners who have appropriate dual use cases and who are experiencing blocks from these probes can apply for exemptions from these safeguards through our Cyber Verification Program.
safeguards_access.note: Cyber Verification Program and access controls for classifier guard exemptions tied to risk.

safeguards_weights.quote: a variety of rapid response options for jailbreaks; and security controls to reduce risk of model weight theft.
safeguards_weights.note: Stated for this model's CB-1 safeguards.
